config.title: Code Review, Mentoring & Culture

intro.title: Code Review, Mentoring & Culture
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a foundational understanding of how code review, mentoring, and culture shape effective engineering teams. You will learn to apply key leadership concepts through structured scenarios and decision-making exercises. The core programming concept involves analyzing code quality, providing constructive feedback, and fostering collaborative practices. The main technologies or constructs include review checklists, feedback frameworks, and culture-building principles, all presented in a beginner-friendly, text-based format.
intro.usecase: This lesson's concepts are essential for maintaining quality in collaborative development environments like GitHub's pull request system, where code review ensures standards compliance. In enterprise platforms like Microsoft Teams or Slack integrations, mentoring practices help onboard developers to complex codebases while fostering knowledge sharing. These principles directly shape the culture in tools like GitLab's merge request workflows and Jira's code review panels, where structured feedback loops prevent technical debt. Implementing effective code review and mentoring creates scalable systems seen in products like AWS CodeCommit's approval workflows and Visual Studio Live Share's collaborative editing features.

objectives: Construct a code review checklist template with automated validation rules
Configure a mentoring session scheduler with pairing logic and availability matching
Implement a feedback collection system with sentiment analysis and actionable insights
Apply cultural metrics dashboards to visualize team health and collaboration patterns
Integrate code quality gates with review workflows to enforce standards
Manipulate knowledge sharing repositories with tagging and search functionality
Initialize team retrospectives with automated agenda generation and outcome tracking

steps.title: Import React and useState
steps.instruction: Import React and useState from 'react' to set up your component with state management capabilities.
steps.hint: Use the import statement to bring in both React and the useState hook from the 'react' package.
steps.analogousExample:
// Example: importing React and a hook
import React, { useState } from 'react';
steps.expectedOutcome: Your file will have the necessary imports to create a React component with state.
successCriteria: React and useState are imported from 'react'.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Nice! Proceed to the next step.
steps.feedbackPartial: You're on the right track, but make sure to import both React and useState from 'react'.
steps.feedbackWrong: Please import both React and useState from 'react' to proceed.

steps.title: Create the CodeReviewCulture component
steps.instruction: Create a functional component named CodeReviewCulture that returns an empty div element.
steps.hint: Define a component using either a function declaration or arrow function syntax, and make it return a div.
steps.seedCode:
import React, { useState } from 'react';

// Create the CodeReviewCulture component here
steps.expectedOutcome: You will have a functional component named CodeReviewCulture that returns an empty div.
successCriteria: The component is named CodeReviewCulture and returns a div element.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Nice! Proceed to the next step.
steps.feedbackPartial: You're close. Make sure your component is named exactly 'CodeReviewCulture' and returns a div element.
steps.feedbackWrong: The component wasn't created correctly. Please create a functional component named CodeReviewCulture that returns a div.

steps.title: Initialize state for code review metrics
steps.instruction: Inside the CodeReviewCulture component, initialize three state variables using useState: reviewCount, averageTime, and qualityScore. Set their initial values to 0.
steps.hint: Use the useState hook three times, each with an initial value of 0. For example: const [reviewCount, setReviewCount] = useState(0);
steps.expectedOutcome: The component will have three state variables initialized with default values of 0, ready to track code review metrics.
successCriteria: reviewCount, averageTime, and qualityScore state variables are initialized with useState and initial values of 0.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Nice! Proceed to the next step.
steps.feedbackPartial: You've initialized some state variables, but make sure you have all three: reviewCount, averageTime, and qualityScore, each with initial value 0.
steps.feedbackWrong: Try again. You need to initialize three state variables using useState: reviewCount, averageTime, and qualityScore, each starting at 0.

steps.title: Initialize state for mentoring activities
steps.instruction: Inside your CodeReviewCulture component, initialize two state variables: 'mentoringSessions' (a number starting at 0) and 'knowledgeShared' (a boolean starting at false) using useState.
steps.hint: Use the useState hook twice, or destructure an array with two elements for each state variable.
steps.expectedOutcome: Your component will have two new state variables to track mentoring engagement metrics.
successCriteria: The component contains state variables 'mentoringSessions' (initialized to 0) and 'knowledgeShared' (initialized to false) using useState.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Nice! Proceed to the next step.
steps.feedbackPartial: You're on the right track, but make sure you have both 'mentoringSessions' (starting at 0) and 'knowledgeShared' (starting at false) initialized with useState.
steps.feedbackWrong: Try again. You need to initialize two state variables inside the component using useState: one for mentoring sessions count and one for knowledge shared status.

steps.title: Define handler for completing a code review
steps.instruction: Inside the CodeReviewCulture component, create a function named handleCompleteReview that updates the reviewCount state and recalculates the qualityScore based on the new count.
steps.hint: Define a function that uses setReviewCount to increment the count, then calculates a new qualityScore (e.g., qualityScore = (reviewCount + 1) * 10) and updates it with setQualityScore.
steps.expectedOutcome: The handleCompleteReview function is defined and ready to update code review metrics when called.
successCriteria: A handleCompleteReview function is defined that updates reviewCount and qualityScore state values.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Nice! Proceed to the next step.
steps.feedbackPartial: You've started defining the function, but make sure it properly updates both reviewCount and qualityScore state values.
steps.feedbackWrong: The function isn't defined correctly. Check that you're using the setter functions to update the state variables.

steps.title: Define handler for conducting a mentoring session
steps.instruction: Define a function called handleMentorSession that updates the mentoringActivities state array by adding a new mentoring session object.
steps.hint: Create a function that takes parameters for the session details and uses setMentoringActivities to add a new object to the array.
steps.expectedOutcome: A handleMentorSession function is defined that can add mentoring session objects to the mentoringActivities state.
successCriteria: The handleMentorSession function is defined and uses setMentoringActivities to update the state array.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Nice! Proceed to the next step.
steps.feedbackPartial: You're on the right track, but make sure your function properly updates the mentoringActivities state using setMentoringActivities.
steps.feedbackWrong: The handleMentorSession function isn't defined correctly. Remember to create a function that updates the mentoringActivities state array.

steps.title: Define handler for improving team culture
steps.instruction: Define a function named handleImproveCulture that updates the collaborationScore and feedbackFrequency properties in the cultureIndicators state object.
steps.hint: Create a function that takes no parameters and uses setCultureIndicators to update the state with new values for collaborationScore and feedbackFrequency.
steps.expectedOutcome: A handleImproveCulture function is defined that updates the cultureIndicators state with increased collaborationScore and feedbackFrequency values.
successCriteria: The handleImproveCulture function is defined and uses setCultureIndicators to update the collaborationScore and feedbackFrequency properties.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Nice! Proceed to the next step.
steps.feedbackPartial: You're on the right track. Make sure your function updates both collaborationScore and feedbackFrequency in the cultureIndicators state object.
steps.feedbackWrong: The function wasn't defined correctly. Remember to create a function named handleImproveCulture that updates the cultureIndicators state with new values for collaborationScore and feedbackFrequency.

steps.title: Add main container and section headers
steps.instruction: In your component, return a main container div with three section headers: 'Code Review Metrics', 'Mentoring Activities', and 'Team Culture Indicators'.
steps.hint: Replace the current return statement with a div containing three h2 elements, each with the appropriate section title text.
steps.expectedOutcome: The component now returns a structured UI with three clear section headers representing the key leadership areas.
successCriteria: The component returns a div containing three h2 elements with the exact text: 'Code Review Metrics', 'Mentoring Activities', and 'Team Culture Indicators'.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Nice! Proceed to the next step.
steps.feedbackPartial: You're on the right track, but make sure you have all three section headers with the exact text specified.
steps.feedbackWrong: The structure doesn't match what was requested. Check that you're returning a div with three h2 elements containing the specified section titles.

steps.title: Display code review metrics and add review button
steps.instruction: Inside the component's return statement, add a section to display the current reviewCount and qualityScore metrics, and include a button that calls handleCompleteReview when clicked.
steps.hint: You'll need to add JSX elements to show the state values and wire the button's onClick event to your handler function.
steps.analogousExample:
// Displaying metrics with a button

Reviews completed: {reviewCount}

Quality score: {qualityScore}
steps.expectedOutcome: The UI will show the current code review metrics (review count and quality score) with an interactive button to complete reviews.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Nice! Proceed to the next step.
steps.feedbackPartial: You've added some elements, but make sure to display both reviewCount and qualityScore, and include a button that calls handleCompleteReview.
steps.feedbackWrong: The code review metrics section isn't complete. You need to display the state values and add a button that triggers the review completion handler.

steps.title: Display culture metrics and add culture button
steps.instruction: Add a section to display the current culture indicators and a button to trigger culture improvement.
steps.hint: You'll need to access the cultureIndicators state object and call the handleImproveCulture function when the button is clicked.
steps.analogousExample:
// Displaying object data and triggering an action

Team Culture

Collaboration Score: {cultureIndicators.collaborationScore}

steps.expectedOutcome: A new section appears showing culture metrics and an interactive button to improve team culture.
successCriteria: The UI displays collaborationScore and feedbackFrequency from cultureIndicators state, and includes a button with onClick handler calling handleImproveCulture.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Nice! Proceed to the next step.
steps.feedbackPartial: You've added some elements, but make sure you're displaying both collaborationScore and feedbackFrequency from the cultureIndicators state, and that your button properly calls the handleImproveCulture function.
steps.feedbackWrong: The culture metrics section isn't displaying correctly. Check that you're accessing the cultureIndicators state object properties and that your button has the correct onClick handler.
